title: A Case Against Implicit Standards: Homophone Normalization in Machine Translation for Languages that use the Ge’ez Script

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation performance (BLEU and ChrF scores) and qualitative output degradation in cross-lingual transfer settings when applying dominant-language (Amharic) homophone normalization preprocessing to other languages that share the same script (Tigrinya and Ge'ez).
